## **Цена и paywall** {#theme-pricing_paywall}

<!--ir-theme:pricing_paywall-->
   **Цена и paywall.**
      1 свежих отзыв(ов) упоминают: цена и paywall.
      Период отзывов: 24 авг. 2026 г. - 24 авг. 2026 г.
      **Что это значит:** Пользователи упоминают цену, подписку или paywall. Это сигнал чувствительности к монетизации.

         **Примеры отзывов:**
            1. _Laura Friedman_, 24 авг. 2026 г., 1/5: "This newly made over health app, that the phone promotes as essential, requires at least two paid subscriptions, of dubious value, to function. Samsung is trying to be as morally bankrupt as Apple. Welcome to the world of being lied to so they can take your money. Samsung advertised these phones and watches that are exorbitantly expensive and then ruined the previous app so that Samsung, Google, and their ilk can grift right on. Shame isn't evidently something that exists anymore."
<!--/ir-theme-->

## **Баги и стабильность** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Баги и стабильность.**
      2 свежих отзыв(ов) упоминают: баги и стабильность.
      Период отзывов: 24 июл. 2026 г. - 27 авг. 2026 г.
      **Что это значит:** Пользователи упоминают краши или нестабильность. Это actionable только при всплеске или после обновления; иначе часто baseline-шум.

         **Примеры отзывов:**
            1. _Tom W_, 27 авг. 2026 г., 1/5: "it got one star because it wasn't anything less... it constantly crashes.. utilizes more space and time than all my other apps combined, and is unfixable. a new Galaxy 9 watch and S26 Ultra phone didn't improve its performance."
            2. _Michael Avalos_, 27 авг. 2026 г., 1/5: "constantly runs in the background and everytime it does it crashes my phone."
            3. _JWM B_, 24 июл. 2026 г., 1/5: "Terrible update, completely ruined the app. Since the latest Samsung Health update, this app has gone downhill fast. The new UI is cluttered and confusing, and honestly feels like a step backward instead of an improvement. Worse, the app crashes constantly, which makes my Samsung Watch practically useless for sports and training. I rely on this thing for tracking workouts, and now I can't trust it to even stay open. This is three steps back, not progress. Really disappointing!"
<!--/ir-theme-->
